_howToUse.purpose: This blueprint is a single source of truth for a frontend. Fill every section that applies. If unknown, use null + add a TODO with owner and due date.
_howToUse.requiredFieldsRule: Fields marked with _required=true must be filled before production.
_howToUse.examplesRule: Where you see _example, replace with your project's real values. Do not leave example values in production.
_howToUse.consistencyRule: IDs referenced across sections (routes -> components -> api contracts -> events) must match exactly.
_howToUse.aiGuidance: Write content so a coding agent can implement without guessing: include routes, data dependencies, error behavior, caching keys, and acceptance tests.

meta._schemaVersion_help: Version of this blueprint schema itself. Increment when you change the template structure.
meta._frontendType_help: One of: web | mobile | desktop | extension.
meta._owners_help: Who maintains the frontend. Include at least one owner.
meta._environments_help: List all environments this frontend runs in.

rules: Use opaque token in URL (not JWT unless necessary)
Token expires quickly (e.g., 1-24h depending on sensitivity)
Do not log full token; mask it
Prevent token leakage via referrer policy (Referrer-Policy: no-referrer)
